methodology.comparator: MAP-BE fitted to the same observed concentrations
methodology.learningTarget: Direct AUC24, squared-error loss; no population AUC predictor or ratio target
methodology.c0: Pre-dose trough at steady state; sampled at tau-epsilon in the equivalent preceding cycle
methodology.c1: Tinf+1 h for intermittent infusion; 1 h for oral, bolus and continuous infusion
methodology.continuous: Ongoing constant-rate infusion at steady state, sampled at t=0 and t=1 h
methodology.truth: Trapezoidal integration of the noise-free individual curve, 0-24 h, step 0.1 h
methodology.residual: Original model SIGMA retained in sparse observations; same observations for MAP and ML
methodology.failures: Bias/RMSE use finite positive estimates; failures count as outside +/-20%. Paired metrics restrict both methods to the same successful patients.
methodology.limitations: Not a replication of Woillard 2021: C0 or C0+C1 instead of C0+C3, different AUC target, residual errors, regimens, filters and cohort size. Benchmark predictors are not the currently deployed Shiny predictors.

results.mapUnavailableReason: $SIGMA. The SIGMA matrix diagonal has length 1. A pair number is expected.
